subject: Banking
title: Lehman Brothers: The Crash Heard Worldwide
description: One-minute skill: Lehman Brothers: The Crash Heard Worldwide.

hook.text: On September 15, 2008, Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy. $639 billion in assets vanished.

buildup.text: Lehman held massive positions in mortgage-backed securities.

discovery.text: The government decided not to bail out Lehman. Officials believed the market could absorb the failure.

twist.text: The money market fund Reserve Primary broke the buck because of Lehman exposure.

climax.text: Lehman's failure proved that one bankruptcy can crash the world economy.

punchline.text: $639 billion bankruptcy. The world economy nearly collapsed in 48 hours.

quiz.question: What happened when the government let Lehman Brothers fail?
options: Global financial panic spread within hours
